tool_call_counting: Each web research-tool invocation counts once, including batched, failed, open, click, and find invocations. Per-answer counts may overlap because a batched invocation can support more than one answer. local_file_read_calls counts the single successful invocation that read the two authorized benchmark snapshots; the failed sandbox attempt read no files.

answers.answer: Treat UPMC Presbyterian and UPMC Shadyside as distinct campuses of the combined hospital operator/record UPMC Presbyterian Shadyside. Use EIN 25-0965480 and CCN 390164. Caveat: retain campus distinctions for campus-specific analysis.

Penn Medicine is not a single legal filer. If the intended filer is The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania (the University/Perelman School side), use EIN 23-1352685. Caveat: specific UPHS hospitals and subsidiaries can have different EINs, so clarify the legal filer.

For operator Thomas Jefferson University Hospitals, Inc. and facility Thomas Jefferson University Hospital, use EIN 23-2829095 and CCN 390174. This is not the EIN of Thomas Jefferson University or the wider Jefferson enterprise.
For UPMC's FY2023 parent-organization Form 990 (fiscal year ended June 30, 2023), use legal filer UPMC, EIN 25-1423657. Select the parent return, not the group/consolidated return.
No. At the close of 2025-03-31, Doylestown Health was not yet part of UPHS; it officially joined on 2025-04-01.
No. At the close of 2024-07-31, LVHN was not yet part of Jefferson; the combination closed on 2024-08-01.

If UPMC Health Plan means legal company UPMC Health Plan, Inc., use EIN 23-2813536. Caveat: UPMC Health Plan is also a marketing name for several issuers, so another product/company can require a different EIN.
Use CCN 390111 for Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania. HUP is a facility/operating component inside Penn Medicine/UPHS, not a separate Penn Medicine enterprise.

For a tax-period 2023 Form 990 request about Jefferson Health Plans, use legal filer Health Partners Plans, Inc., EIN 23-2379751. Jefferson Health Plans is the brand/fictitious name; the legal filer did not change.

Selected perimeter: include the controlled UPMC enterprise across Health Services (hospitals/provider entities) and Insurance Services; exclude the University of Pittsburgh. The University is a separately incorporated affiliated related party, not part of UPMC ownership.

Penn Medicine means UPHS plus the Perelman School of Medicine. It is broader than UPHS alone but narrower than the whole University. For provider operations, an explicitly labeled UPHS-only perimeter is reasonable.

Selected current enterprise perimeter: Thomas Jefferson University, Jefferson Health, Jefferson Health Plans, and post-closing LVHN operations. Jefferson Health is not the same legal scope as Thomas Jefferson University Hospitals, Inc.; TJUH is a specific hospital operator inside the broader system.
